item.title: iPhone 18 Pro Leaks Reveal Under-Display Face ID, Brighter Screens
item.description: Future Pro iPhone models are expected to feature a significant screen redesign, with reports indicating a major visual overhaul for the display. This change could include the flood illuminator, a component essential for Face ID, being hidden beneath the screen. Such a development would account for a smaller or shrunken Dynamic Island.

item.title: Apple Unveils New AirTag With Enhanced Range, Louder Speaker
item.description: Apple has unveiled its next-generation AirTag, featuring the same Apple Ultra Wideband chip found in the recent iPhone 17 lineup, the lightweight iPhone Air, the Apple Watch Ultra 3, and the Apple Watch Series 11. This integration expands its findability range and enables compatibility with more Apple devices.

item.title: Kuaishou's Kling Challenges Google, OpenAI in AI Video Generation Market
item.description: China’s Kuaishou has established its Kling platform as a top-tier competitor in AI video generation, challenging Google’s Veo and OpenAI’s Sora. Launched in June 2024, Kling has rapidly gained about 12 million monthly active users and an annual recurring revenue of roughly USD 240 million. item.title: Robot Dogs with Rifles Unveiled at Indian Army Rehearsal
item.description: The Indian army showcased rifle-mounted robotic dogs during rehearsals for the Republic Day parade in New Delhi. These four-legged machines, built for navigating rough ground, garnered significant attention from onlookers and defence experts.

item.title: Football Manager Roberto Moreno Sacked Over ChatGPT Reliance at FC Sochi
item.description: Former Spain head coach Roberto Moreno was dismissed from his recent coaching position at Russian club FC Sochi. His sacking stemmed from an over-reliance on the artificial intelligence programme ChatGPT, which reportedly led him to ignore common sense.

item.title: Adobe Photoshop Updates Enhance Creative Control, AI Realism
item.description: Adobe has introduced new features for Photoshop, aiming to enhance creative control and streamline workflows for content creators. These updates are designed to reduce tedious tasks, elevate workflows, and give creatives more precision and control over their work. Credit: ADOBE Photoshop now includes new adjustment layers for non-destructive editing, featuring Clarity, Dehaze, and Grain. These controls provide powerful, maskable, layer-based adjustments to refine texture, depth, and detail....

item.title: DeepSeek Enhances OCR Performance with Alibaba Open-Source AI
item.description: DeepSeek, a Chinese artificial intelligence startup, has launched an upgraded version of its optical character recognition, or OCR, model, DeepSeek-OCR 2. This update incorporates an open-source system developed by Alibaba Cloud to significantly boost performance.

item.title: Jack Ma Calls for Rural Education Reform in AI Era
item.description: Alibaba Group Holding founder Jack Ma recently urged a fundamental shift in China’s rural education system. He said the artificial intelligence era requires moving away from rote learning to fostering curiosity and creativity in students.

item.title: Waymo Targets London Launch by Late 2026
item.description: U.S. robotaxi company Waymo aims to launch its fully driverless ride-hailing service in London by the fourth quarter of 2026. The firm, a unit of Google parent Alphabet, seeks to expand its international presence. Credit: Waymo Waymo has experienced steady growth in the United States despite strict regulations and costly technology. item.title: Amazon Announces 16,000 Corporate Job Cuts Amid AI Shift and Cost Reduction
item.description: Amazon is eliminating approximately 16,000 corporate positions, marking its second significant round of layoffs in three months. The e-commerce giant cited plans to use generative artificial intelligence (AI) to replace corporate workers. The company has also been reducing a workforce that swelled during the pandemic.
